title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity + version bump v1.87.0
author: Priya Ramanathan
description:
Motivation:
Unify SDK behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go for auth handling, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics. This PR consolidates smaller parity fixes we shipped independently, improves ergonomics for streaming usage patterns, and bumps SDK package versions to v1.87.0.

What this changes (high level):
- Centralized auth token refresh logic and consistent failure modes across SDKs.
- Standardized retry/backoff defaults and exposed a small API for policy overrides.
- Improved streaming API ergonomics (cancellation, reconnect, and typed events) to match behavior between languages.
- Small surface parity fixes: consistent error types, improved docstrings, example parity in quickstarts.
- Version bumps for all SDK packages to v1.87.0 and changelog entries.

Checklist:
- [x] Python: auth + retries + streaming ergonomics + tests
- [x] TypeScript: auth + retries + streaming ergonomics + tests + types
- [x] Go: auth + retries + streaming ergonomics + examples + tests
- [x] Update changelogs / release notes
- [x] E2E smoke tests on CI (passed)

Compatibility notes:
- Default retry/backoff is tightened slightly (fewer retries for 4xx client errors). We keep opt-out and custom policy hooks; existing users will not see behavior change unless they rely on previously unbounded retries.
- Auth refresh now raises a single SDKError subclass on failure to make handling consistent across languages.

For reviewers: see per-language files and test matrix. Reasonable to squash-merge since changes are cross-language grouped.
